summary: The desktop opens a chat with its newest 200-row history window (history_window_v1) and loads older windows when the list nears its top, keeping the row in view in place. Windowed loads may ask imageRefs (history_image_refs_v1): base64 history images become references served by app:load-history-image when a thumbnail scrolls into view. The backend parses the largest profile copy of a session and skips copies proven by sha256 to be its byte prefix, and a cached transcript that grew parses only its new bytes after the old bytes hash to the cached digest. Search, export, fork anchors and the handoff preamble keep the full history.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app already loads 200-row windows and never sends imageRefs, so it keeps receiving data URLs from the same handler. The new capability string is additive; MessageImage.ref is optional and never reaches a client that did not ask for it.

nativeAndroid.reason: Android already pages with history_window_v1 and never sends imageRefs, so its responses are unchanged. app:load-history-image is open to the chat scope, which already receives the same image bytes inside history, so a phone gains no new power.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, stored transcript or setting changes. The parse cache and the image reference map are bounded, process-local and rebuilt on demand; a missing image reference falls back to reading the history.

automated: tests/unit/desktop-history-window.test.ts: paging from the newest window back to the first row with no gap or repeat, overlap removal, full-history cut at the cursor, the load-older trigger, anchor lookup, and whole-history detection for export.

tests/unit/history-image-refs.test.ts: references only when asked (phones and older desktops keep data URLs), byte sizes, serving remembered bytes without a reload, the history fallback and clean misses.

tests/unit/jsonl-copies.test.ts: prefix digests across chunk boundaries, prefix-copy skip on a miss and a cache hit, a diverged copy parsed, append-only parse with object reuse, full parse after an in-place rewrite and after a cached state that ended mid-line.

Built app (SB_E2E_BACKGROUND=1, isolated SB_USER_DATA, demo adapter) with a copied 98 MB Claude transcript in five provider dirs as byte prefixes: first open chat.open 923 ms, reopens 420 to 492 ms, payloadBytes 131 KB; scrolling to the top logged chat.load-older (about 400 ms) with the view anchored, and 112 history images loaded as they scrolled into view.
notExercised: No phone run: phone requests are unchanged by construction.
Codex rollout copies are still parsed one by one; only Claude profile copies are deduplicated by prefix proof.
The SQLite mirror read and the merge with it still run over the whole history on every open (about 0.5 s each for an 8,700-row chat in the original log); the window bounds the payload, not that work.
